source: Pretto et al. 2018, Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 185, Fig. 11A: strict consensus with Bagualosaurus agudoensis (red); rectangular, root left, small type, bootstrap above and Bremer below each node, silhouettes. Panel B (the same taxa under another analysis) is excluded. Image: census figure (1170x726 px), the embedded raster.
region_note: panel A; panel B to its right repeats the same tips under another analysis. Panel A's lower labels run on under panel B's upper left, to about x 705, so the region reaches x 715 and the part of panel B inside it is excluded. Until tree extractor 0.12.0 the region stopped at x 515 and cut fourteen labels short.
license: unverified: no licence statement in the text held
names_note: no matrix held; list = the 44 printed tip names of panel A as printed, including 'Petrified forest teropod' (sic) and 'Chindesaurus briansmalli'
gold_note: Early dinosauriform strict consensus, panel A, read from 3x crops and the close nodes at 8x. Four nodes are multi-way: Saltopus/Lewisuchus/Pseudolagosuchus with the rest; the Diodorus-Silesaurus-Sacisaurus node; the Scutellosaurus node (entered at Eocursor's height); and Petrified forest teropod, Dilophosaurus and the coelophysid clade, which leave one vertical below Dilophosaurus. No clade names are printed; the numbers are bootstrap and Bremer values. 44 tips, 4 polytomies (4, 3, 4, 3 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
